title: ALMANAC: New Arrivals | Almanac | codyenterprise.com
text:
Violet Marie Grace Henry was born on May 6, 2026 to Addison West and Michael Henry of Cody. Born at West Park Hospital, she weighed 7lbs and 1oz at birth. Violet’s grandparents are Amy and Eddie Hebbler, and Mike and Tammie Henry. At home, she joins siblings Rose West (7) and Lincoln Hebbler (5).
